# gh-achievements

> Check your GitHub achievements progress: every badge, your tier and how far to the next one, verified against GitHub's own data, no token needed.

gh-achievements is an open source GitHub CLI extension (MIT). Install with `gh extension install nmloc/gh-achievements`, run `gh achievements [username]`. It reads tiers, unlock dates and milestone history from GitHub's own profile pages and counts progress with the user's existing gh login, so no personal access token is created. A web checker at https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/check/ shows the same report without installing anything. It knows 15 achievements (8 earnable, 2 disabled, 2 retired, 3 internal) and 6 profile highlights. Catalog last verified 2026-10-17. It is not affiliated with GitHub.

## Achievements

- [Pull Shark](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/pull-shark/): Open pull requests that get merged. Tiers: 2 · 16 · 128 · 1024. Earnable.
- [Starstruck](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/starstruck/): Create a repository that gets stars. Tiers: 16 · 128 · 512 · 4096. Earnable.
- [Pair Extraordinaire](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/pair-extraordinaire/): Coauthor commits on merged pull requests. Tiers: 1 · 10 · 24 · 48. Earnable.
- [Galaxy Brain](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/galaxy-brain/): Have discussion answers accepted. Tiers: 2 · 8 · 16 · 32. Earnable.
- [Quickdraw](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/quickdraw/): Close an issue or pull request within 5 minutes of opening it. Tiers: one tier. Earnable.
- [YOLO](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/yolo/): Merge a pull request without a review. Tiers: one tier. Earnable.
- [Public Sponsor](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/public-sponsor/): Sponsor someone publicly through GitHub Sponsors. Tiers: one tier. Earnable.
- [Finishing Touch](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/finishing-touch/): Get pull requests that improve GitHub's UI quality merged. Tiers: 1 · 4 · 16 · 32. Earnable.
- [Heart On Your Sleeve](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/heart-on-your-sleeve/): React to something on GitHub with a ❤️ emoji. Tiers: ? · 16 · 128 · ?. Disabled (tested, not earnable now).
- [Open Sourcerer](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/open-sourcerer/): Have pull requests merged in several public repositories. Tiers: ? · 8 · 16 · 64. Disabled (tested, not earnable now).
- [Arctic Code Vault Contributor](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/arctic-code-vault-contributor/): Code in a repository of the 2020 GitHub Archive Program. Tiers: one tier. Retired (no longer earnable).
- [Mars 2020 Contributor](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/mars-2020-contributor/): Code in a repository used by the Mars 2020 Helicopter Mission. Tiers: one tier. Retired (no longer earnable).
- [Proxima Pioneer](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/proxima-pioneer/): GitHub staff: contributed to the Proxima proof of concept. Tiers: one tier. Internal (GitHub staff only).
- [Proxima Staffshipper](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/proxima-staffshipper/): GitHub staff: shipped the Proxima staffship instance. Tiers: one tier. Internal (GitHub staff only).
- [Proxima Staffuser](https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/proxima-staffuser/): GitHub staff: your team was onboarded to Proxima. Tiers: one tier. Internal (GitHub staff only).

# Pull Shark (GitHub achievement)

URL: https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/pull-shark/
Status: Earnable
How to earn: Open pull requests that get merged
Tiers: 2 · 16 · 128 · 1024

Pull Shark counts pull requests you opened that were merged. GitHub's own history for the badge names the 2nd, 16th, 128th and 1024th merged pull request.

Q: How many merged pull requests do you need for Pull Shark?
A: 2 for the base badge, 16 for x2 (bronze), 128 for x3 (silver) and 1024 for x4 (gold).

Q: Do pull requests in private repositories count towards Pull Shark?
A: Yes. GitHub's Pull Shark history lists milestones in private repositories as "inaccessible", so they are counted even though visitors cannot see them.

---

# Starstruck (GitHub achievement)

URL: https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/starstruck/
Status: Earnable
How to earn: Create a repository that gets stars
Tiers: 16 · 128 · 512 · 4096

Starstruck counts the stars of a repository you created. GitHub's history for the badge names the repository that reached each threshold.

Q: How many stars do you need for Starstruck?
A: One repository with 16 stars for the base badge, 128 for x2, 512 for x3 and 4096 for x4.

Q: Do stars across several repositories add up for Starstruck?
A: No. The thresholds apply to a single repository; GitHub's history names one repository per threshold.

---

# Pair Extraordinaire (GitHub achievement)

URL: https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/pair-extraordinaire/
Status: Earnable
How to earn: Coauthor commits on merged pull requests
Tiers: 1 · 10 · 24 · 48

Pair Extraordinaire is awarded for coauthored commits on merged pull requests. GitHub's history for the badge lists the pull request and the coauthors for each threshold, including pull requests opened by someone else that list you as a coauthor.

Q: How many coauthored pull requests do you need for Pair Extraordinaire?
A: 1 for the base badge, 10 for x2, 24 for x3 and 48 for x4.

Q: Why does gh-achievements show no counter for Pair Extraordinaire?
A: GitHub's counting rule is not public. On a real account, 60 merged pull requests had commits with a Co-authored-by trailer while GitHub's tier said 10 to 23, so any count from the API would be wrong. The tool shows the official tier only.

---

# Galaxy Brain (GitHub achievement)

URL: https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/galaxy-brain/
Status: Earnable
How to earn: Have discussion answers accepted
Tiers: 2 · 8 · 16 · 32

Galaxy Brain counts your GitHub Discussions answers that were marked as the accepted answer. Since 2024-02-06 answers in GitHub's own Community Discussions (github.com/orgs/community) no longer count.

Q: How many accepted answers do you need for Galaxy Brain?
A: 2 for the base badge, 8 for x2, 16 for x3 and 32 for x4.

Q: Do answers in GitHub Community Discussions count for Galaxy Brain?
A: Not since 2024-02-06, when GitHub stopped awarding achievements there to counter spam. Answers in other repositories' discussions still count.

---

How to earn: Close an issue or pull request within 5 minutes of opening it
Tiers: one tier

Quickdraw ("Gitty up!") is a one-time badge for closing an issue or pull request within 5 minutes of opening it.

YOLO ("You want it? You merge it.") is a one-time badge for merging a pull request without a code review.

URL: https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/public-sponsor/
Status: Earnable
How to earn: Sponsor someone publicly through GitHub Sponsors
Tiers: one tier

Public Sponsor is a one-time badge for sponsoring an open source contributor or organization through GitHub Sponsors with a public sponsorship. Private sponsorships do not count.

---

# Finishing Touch (GitHub achievement)

URL: https://gh-achievements.vercel.app/achievements/finishing-touch/
Status: Earnable
How to earn: Get pull requests that improve GitHub's UI quality merged
Tiers: 1 · 4 · 16 · 32

Finishing Touch counts merged pull requests that GitHub classed as improving the quality of its own user interface. GitHub's history for the badge names the 1st, 4th, 16th and 32nd UI quality pull request merged.

Q: How many pull requests do you need for Finishing Touch?
A: 1 merged UI quality pull request for the base badge, 4 for x2, 16 for x3 and 32 for x4.

Status: Disabled (tested, not earnable now)
How to earn: React to something on GitHub with a ❤️ emoji
Tiers: ? · 16 · 128 · ?

Heart On Your Sleeve was tested by GitHub and is switched off: nobody can earn it now. The known thresholds are 16 ❤️ reactions for x2 and 128 for x3.

# How accurate is gh-achievements

## Three labels

gh-achievements labels every number. official: read from GitHub's own profile pages. calibrated: counted through the GitHub API, then checked against a milestone GitHub itself names. counted: counted through the API with nothing public to check it against.

## GitHub's own record of each badge

When you open a badge on a profile, GitHub loads /users/<user>/achievements/<slug>/detail. That page lists the tier, the first unlock date and history rows naming the pull request, repository or answer behind each milestone. Rows in private repositories say "inaccessible". None of this is in GitHub's REST or GraphQL API.

## Calibration

For Pull Shark, GitHub names which merged pull request was its 2nd, 16th, 128th and 1024th. gh-achievements lists your merged pull requests in merge order and finds the highest milestone it can see. For @torvalds, GitHub's 16th is subsurface/subsurface#1506, and it is also 16th in the API's list, so the two counts agree (+0). Any difference is added to the live count, so pull requests the API cannot show you are still counted.

## An official tier is never contradicted

A tier GitHub granted is never taken back, so a count below that tier's threshold is raised to it. A count above GitHub's tier is shown with "count says xN", because GitHub can lag behind the count.

## Why Pair Extraordinaire has no counter

GitHub's rule for which coauthored commits count is not public, and the obvious rule is wrong. On the author's own account, 60 merged pull requests had commits with a Co-authored-by trailer while GitHub's tier said 10 to 23, and GitHub's first unlock (2024-12-17) came before the first such pull request (2026-05-28). Commit search's co-author: qualifier returned commits co-authored by other people. So the tool shows GitHub's tier and no number.

## Known limits

GitHub search lists at most 1000 pull requests, so above that Pull Shark keeps the exact total but skips calibration. Counts only include what your gh login can see. Galaxy Brain is counted, not calibrated. Starstruck takes the most-starred repository among the ones GitHub names and the ones you own; the star count itself is live API data. Galaxy Brain's count includes answers in GitHub Community discussions, which stopped counting in 2024, so it can run high. The official pages are HTML, so a weekly canary job checks them against real profiles and opens an issue when GitHub changes them.

## No token, no server

gh-achievements uses the credentials gh already stores (or GH_TOKEN). Without them it falls back to public data. It talks only to github.com and api.github.com; there is no gh-achievements server.

# FAQ

Q: How do I check my GitHub achievements progress?
A: Install the GitHub CLI extension with `gh extension install nmloc/gh-achievements` and run `gh achievements`. It lists every achievement, your tier and how many more you need for the next one. Add a username to check someone else.

Q: Does gh-achievements need a GitHub token?
A: No. It reuses the login of the GitHub CLI (gh auth login). Without a login it still works with public data.

Q: How many GitHub achievements are there?
A: 15 are known as of 2026-10-17: 8 earnable, 2 disabled, 2 retired, 3 internal. There are also 6 profile highlights such as Pro and Developer Program Member.

Q: How accurate is it?
A: Tiers and unlock dates come straight from GitHub's profile pages. Pull Shark's count is checked against the milestones GitHub names. Every number is labelled official, calibrated or counted.

Q: Why don't my achievements show on my profile?
A: Achievements can be turned off under Settings → Public profile → "Show Achievements on my profile". gh-achievements says when a profile hides them and shows live counts only.

Q: Is gh-achievements made by GitHub?
A: No. It is an independent open source project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by GitHub.
